## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Documentation or changelog updated when user-visible behavior changes

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private endpoints, or sensitive paths are included
- [ ] Permission, authentication, network, persistence, and destructive-operation impacts were considered
- [ ] Backward-compatibility or migration implications are documented when applicable
